ci.failed_attempt_observation: PATCH /api/v1/office/agents/<seeded-agent>/status returned 400: invalid status transition from stopped to paused at the test's pre-pause setup.
ci.failed_attempt_trace: not present; the available trace is from passing retry 1

source.change: The API-only reassignment test now resets its worker-scoped Office workspace, then explicitly transitions the seeded CEO to idle before the existing pause setup. The terminal session-state poll and assertion remain unchanged.
source.diff: Five added lines only; no shared helpers or production files changed.

proven: The failed API request observed the seeded agent in stopped state immediately before the test attempted paused.
Office status contract permits stopped to idle, and idle to paused; stopped to paused is rejected.
The test does not request testPage. The office-fixture testPage fixture performs the per-test workspace reset, while officeSeed is worker-scoped.
CI shard 11 metadata lists agent-skills-ui.spec.ts, agents.spec.ts, and routine-catch-up-policy-ui.spec.ts before session-lifecycle.spec.ts among its assigned Office files.
causality.inference: Stale worker-scoped Office tasks or their cleanup likely left the seeded agent stopped. The exact event that wrote stopped cannot be identified because attempt 0 has no trace. Resetting the workspace waits for its task cleanup, and the explicit stopped-to-idle recovery uses the valid API transition before pausing.
causality.confidence_limit: The isolated baseline title and the baseline lifecycle file both passed locally; this run did not reproduce the CI failure before the fix. Their passes are not treated as proof that the flake was absent.
